page.layout: One printed page, one column of running text. Marginal notes in the left margin, at the lines they stand beside. Running head at top centre, page number at top left. A small mark at the bottom left, below the text.

main_text.p: Antiocho filio, qui annum unum &men.[?]1.Mac.8.ses lex regnaverat, interfecto. Hoc regnante, primum Judaei a populo Romano amicitiam foedusq; petiere: benigneq; excepta legatio, decreto Senatus socii atque amici appellati. Interim Demetrius adver-sus Judam per duces suos bellum gerebat.

1.Mac.7.Ac primum per Bacchidem quendam & Alcimus pontifex qui & Iacimus.{a}Alchimū ludęum ductus exercitus: post Nicanor bello praepositus in praelio occu-buit. Tum Bacchides & Alchimus re-sumptis viribus, auctifque copiis, adver-sum Judam confligunt. In ea pugna vi-ctores Syri, cruente admodum victoria sunt usi. Ionatha fac. & dux.Hebraei in locum Judae Ionathan fratrem ejus deligunt. Interea Alchi-mus cum foede Hierosolymam vastasset, moritur. Bacchides socio destitutus, ad regem redit. Dein post biennium rursus Bacchides bellum Judæis intulit, victus pacem petit. Quæ propositis conditioni-bus data, si perfugas captivosque & o-mnia bello rapta redderet.de transfugis red. Dum hæc intra Judaeam geruntur, dedis nul-la mentio, nec in Io-sepho,necadolescens quidam Rhodi educatus, nomine Alexander, An-tiochi se esse filium dictitans, (quod fal-sum erat) adjutus opibus Ptolemaei regis Alexan-in libro Macha-beorum. 1.Mach.10.

page.notes: Doubtful: "&men.[?]" at the end of the first line; the word may be broken as "&men-ses" with the hyphen not clearly printed. Margin notes are set in small type and their line placement is approximate. Marginal "de transfugis red." and "dedis nul-la mentio, nec in Io-sepho,nec in libro Macha-beorum" are run together in the margin; I split them by line. The printed "hde" before "trans" in the margin was read as "de"; the "h" is probably a stray mark. "auctifque", "ludęum", "praelio" and "foedusq;" are copied as printed. The small "V" at the bottom left is not transcribed as a signature, because it is unclear whether it is a gathering mark. Long s is plain s throughout. The text ends with the half word "Alexan-", which is not a catchword. The running head has been given u/v spelling, so "SVLPICII" reads "SULPICII".
